title: Children Review Questions
description: Deterministic reviewer questions for the children domain.

entries.title: Who is vulnerable?
entries.description: Identify the child or vulnerable person before judging the scene.

entries.title: Who speaks?
entries.description: Identify the speaker, narrator, or quoted voice.

entries.title: Who is targeted?
entries.description: Separate direct targets from implied targets.

entries.title: What happened?
entries.description: Decide whether the scene shows abuse, neglect, protection, or neutral observation.

entries.title: What is the intent?
entries.description: Check whether the line encourages harm, condemns it, or remains neutral.

entries.title: What is the context?
entries.description: Check for educational, medical, documentary, court, or fictional framing.

entries.title: What is the evidence?
entries.description: Locate the exact literal phrase or action that matters.

entries.title: Is it safe?
entries.description: Decide whether the scene is protective, harmful, or ambiguous.
